cohort_selection_rationale: A deliberately narrow validation cohort selected before classification: one public Python client library that directly declared httpx and had active public development during the observation window. It is a product validation sample, not a representative population.

accepted_events.title: release: 1.55.3

evidence.excerpt: Bug Fixes: client compatibility with the new httpx 0.28.0 release. The release PR references fix commit 72b6c636c526885ef873580a07eff1c18e76bc10.

accepted_events.evidence_reason: Rule text.version_specific_remediation: The artifact names the target package and version and contains a remediation term. Human review must confirm the described action. Review: Accepted: the merged release PR explicitly describes client compatibility with httpx 0.28.0 and links the implementing commit.

accepted_events.title: httpx 0.28.0 removed proxies in httpx.Client, result in error

evidence.excerpt: The report shows httpx==0.28.0 with openai==1.54.4 and TypeError: Client.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'proxies'. The issue was closed as completed and links the fix in pull request #1905.

accepted_events.evidence_reason: Rule text.version_specific_friction: The artifact names the target package and version and contains a friction term. Human review must verify that the surrounding context is qualifying evidence. Review: Accepted: the primary issue names httpx 0.28.0, the removed proxies argument, the exact TypeError, and affected openai-python version 1.54.4.

metrics.name: observed_adoption_evidence_coverage
metrics.qualification_rule: Repositories with accepted observed-adoption evidence / declared cohort repositories. This measures evidence coverage, not an adoption rate. Zero means no accepted adoption evidence; unknown remains unknown and does not establish absence of adoption.

metrics.name: friction_incidence
metrics.qualification_rule: Accepted friction event / repositories with observed adoption.
